reader.requirement: At --std 85 an SD must be followed by at least one record description entry (a record-less SD is refused), and no input-output statement (OPEN in every mode, CLOSE, READ, WRITE, REWRITE, START, DELETE) may name the sort or merge file; SORT/MERGE/RELEASE/RETURN remain legal.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectLevel < 2002 returns: the 2002+ rule against naming an SD record's items as operands of another file's I-O statement is not asked at 1985 (1985 has no such rule)

reader.edition-search: Read the SD arm of BindFileSection (record-less SD -> COBOL1837, unconditional) and ScreenSortMergeFile (unconditional, COBOL1692) and each caller (OPEN/READ/WRITE/REWRITE via UnsupportedOrg, CLOSE, DELETE, START); grepped DialectLevel/EditionContext in those members: only ScreenSortMergeRecordReferences consults the edition.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: both halves refused identically at 85 and 2023 (only the sibling 2002+ SR4 record-operand screen is skipped at 85, correctly)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f26_04 exercises only the permitted form (two records, SORT/RELEASE/RETURN); the refusal halves (record-less SD, I-O statements on the SD) are not exercised by it

probes.printed: error COBOL1837: sort-merge file description entry 'SRT': one or more record description entries shall be associated ... (exit 65)
probes.expected: refused: one or more record description entries must follow the SD

probes.printed: COBOL1692 on each of OPEN INPUT/OUTPUT/I-O/EXTEND, READ, WRITE, REWRITE, START, DELETE, CLOSE of SD SRT (10 errors, exit 65); same at --std 2023
probes.expected: no input-output statements may be executed for this sort or merge file: each refused
legal SD with RECORD VARYING DEPENDING ON and an ODO record sorts descending on SR-K and returns each record at its length

reader.notes: Both halves of SR3 are enforced at --std 85 by the same unconditional code the latest edition uses. The diagnostics at --std 85 cite ISO §2023:13.4.6.3 rather than §1985:XI.3.2.3 SR3 (a message-text matter, not a conformance failure).
reader.at-2023: same refusals (COBOL1692 at each I-O statement)

refuter.evidence: Probes under E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-241 at --std 85. sd_io2.cob (SD in a multi-file OPEN INPUT F1 SRT / OPEN OUTPUT F1 SRT, READ SRT NEXT RECORD, bare READ SRT, WRITE SR-A FROM WS-R, CLOSE F1 SRT): COBOL1692 on every statement naming SRT, exit 65. sd_norec2.cob (SD directly followed by an FD with its own 01) and sd_norec3.cob (record-less SD carrying RECORD CONTAINS and DATA RECORD IS): COBOL1837 each, exit 65, so the following FD's record is not credited to the SD. sd_recops.cob (class c: the 2002+ ban on SD record items as operands of another file's I-O is no 1985 rule): WRITE F1-R FROM SR-A and READ F1 INTO SR-A compile and run at 85, printing 12AB, exit 0. cite.py: OK  §1985:XI.3.2.3 SR3  (3.2.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR3.
